name: Myntmore
description: Myntmore is a Mumbai-based, AI-powered B2B outbound agency. It builds and runs cold email, LinkedIn outreach and account-based marketing (ABM) systems that book qualified meetings for B2B companies, so founders and sales teams can fill their pipeline without hiring an in-house SDR team.
